high_level_description: This image depicts an interior room with light green walls and a large wooden cabinet as the central focus. The cabinet has a traditional design with a curved top and ornate detailing, including small decorative elements on the upper part. It features multiple shelves and compartments, some of which appear to be empty. To the left of the cabinet, there is a wall-mounted sink with a white basin and a faucet. Above the sink, there is a small blue poster or painting hanging on the wall.
